title: Possible a one-time-password secret literal assigned to OTP_SECRET in source
description: The file contains a one-time-password secret literal assigned to OTP_SECRET. Key material in source lets anyone with read access derive the same signatures or decrypt the same data until the key is retired. Shape-only: the match does not prove the key is live.
remediation: Retire the key, re-issue it with the narrowest scope that still works, and load the replacement from a KMS or secret manager rather than from the repository.
limitation: Shape-only: a 16+ character base64 or hex literal assigned to a key-material name. It cannot distinguish a working key from a rotated or test key.
